notes: Checked main mega-menu JSON embedded in the homepage RSC payload (L0 nav: SALE, READY TO SHIP, WOMEN, MEN, HOME, JEWELRY, SAREE, GIFTING, CRAFTS, BLOG), every sub-group under each (HOME alone has 21 sub-groups: BED LINEN, TABLE LINEN, FLOOR COVERING, BAKEWARE, DECOR, IDOLS, WALLPAPER, LIGHTING, FURNITURE, OUTDOOR, ART, GIFT SETS, ALL JEWELRY, House of fashion, HOUSE OF SILVER, SILVER AT OLD RATES, The Saree Store, Shop by Occasion, Shop by Color Family, SHOP BY FABRIC, SHOP BY CRAFT), the footer, and the homepage CMS section names (Home Banner Carousel, Reclaim Your Roots, Popular Categories, Jaypore Features, Featured Collections, Jaypore Finest, Brand Spotlight, Jaypore Craft Treasures, Skinny Banner). None of these contain a Bestsellers/Popular/Trending/Favorites nav item at any level. Exhaustively grepped sitemap-categories.xml (5727 URLs) for bestsell/best-sell/top-seller/popular/trending/most-loved/favorite/favourite keywords. Result: no single canonical, nav-anchored Bestsellers page exists; instead the site has accumulated >15 one-off marketing-collection slugs using bestseller/hotsellers/favorites/most-loved naming, none linked from navigation (sitemap-only discovery): eoss-bestseller, eoss-hotsellers, seasons-bestsellers, shop-bestsellers-save-big-flat50off, bestseller-diaries, bestselling-earrings, bestselling-weaves, bestselling-summer-picks, bestselling-sarees (these 4 are jewelry/apparel only, out of Home Decor scope), jaypore-favorites, most-loved-finds, silver-favorites, ready-to-ship-favorites, most-loved-styles-for-him, most-loved-summer-stories, going-out-favorites, indias-most-loved-crafts-for-summer, new-season-favorites, artful-favorites, most-loved-traditional-jewels, up-to-30-off-your-summer-favorites, your-favorites-always, your-everyday-favorites. Verified exact Home-Decor-scoped product counts (via the Gender__fq:Home+Decor facet filter, the same technique the prior Home-Decor pass used for Mirrors/Planters) for 7 of these via Playwright rendering: eoss-bestseller=50, eoss-hotsellers=22, shop-bestsellers-save-big-flat50off=21, most-loved-finds=291, jaypore-favorites=18 (all emitted as rows below); seasons-bestsellers=0 and bestseller-diaries=0 Home Decor products (dropped, out of scope, pure apparel). The remaining ~10 'favorites'-family slugs were not individually checked (time-bounded sampling of the clearest candidates; two of them -- your-favorites-always, your-everyday-favorites -- were opened but the GENDER-facet click timed out before a count could be read). All 5 emitted rows are flagged MANUAL REVIEW because none of these collections are reachable from site navigation (only via sitemap crawl) and several are explicitly tied to the EOSS End-of-Season-Sale campaign rather than being an evergreen site feature -- a human should decide final inclusion/consolidation policy, and whether to extend the sweep to the unverified favorites-family tail. Access: direct HTTPS fetch (requests/curl) for HTML, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml worked with no block and no Claude-specific robots.txt disallow. Playwright/CDP (tier 2) was required to read exact product counts and apply the Home Decor facet filter, because -- consistent with the prior Home-Decor pass's finding -- the real product grid/counts load client-side via an internal API that plain HTTP fetch cannot reproduce; Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) was not needed.
